title: Card & app
line: Design your member experience and connect Apple and Google Wallet.
nameSource: Uses your workspace name. Manage this name in the full admin’s settings.
logoHint: Your workspace name appears until you add a logo.
logoImmediate: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB. Uploaded logos are saved immediately.
uploadFailed: The logo could not be saved. Check the file and try again.
logoSaved: Logo saved. Discarding appearance changes keeps this logo.
autoHint: The member app uses one saved colour palette. Automatic light and dark switching is not supported. Choose Dark or Light, then save the colours.
walletBranding: Wallet passes use their saved connection settings and each provider’s own layout.
saveHint: Save to update the member app’s appearance.
saved: Saved. The member app shows these colours the next time it opens.
saveFailed: Your appearance was not saved. Your changes are still here; try again.
fixFields: Check the highlighted fields, including More appearance options.
stale: These settings could not be refreshed. Retry before editing.
discardHint: Discard the colour and style changes? Uploaded logos stay saved.
leaveHint: Your appearance changes have not been saved. Uploaded logos will remain.
codeHint: This is a non-scannable example. A real member’s code is available from their own card or member profile.
sampleCode: Example only · not a member credential
walletPreviewHint: Members add their own card through their signed-in account when a wallet connection is ready. This preview does not create a pass.
rewardPreviewHint: This is an example of your reward catalogue. Real eligibility and points are checked for the signed-in member; no reward is claimed here.
benefitPreviewHint: This preview shows the number of configured benefits, not the selected example member’s entitlement. Real benefits depend on the member’s level and programme rules.
noRewards: No active points rewards to preview.
benefitsCount: {{n}} configured benefits · eligibility varies by member
walletLocked: Your plan does not include wallet passes. Member app appearance remains available.
walletUnavailable: Wallet connections could not be loaded.
testGuidance: Confirm provider approval, then test adding and updating a card on your own test member’s device.
connectFirst: Connect and switch on the provider before testing a pass.
additionalRequirement: Review the connection settings for an additional requirement.
testNoSample: This application does not generate anonymous sample passes.
testStep1: Sign in to the member app using an authorized test member account.
testStep2: Open that member’s card and choose {{provider}} on a compatible device.
testStep3: Check the saved name, colours and member details before sharing the connection.
testNoWrite: Opening this guide does not create or change a member, pass or wallet connection.
